TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Obtains information about the pricing rule. Allows you to filter by various parameters.
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() reads pricingRuleId, pricingRuleType, pricingRuleStatus, fromDate, toDate, activityId, segmentId, settlementId, onlyActive, pageNumber, sizeOfPage, attributeDesc and attributeName, and if getPricingruleid() is not null and lower than 0 it emits ABKO00000050 with Severity.WARN, sets an empty pricingRules list in dataPricingRuleGet, assigns dataOfPricingRules and returns. 2. Decisions and branches: after the negative identifier check, execute() copies all input fields into PricingRuleGetFilterParams, and ABKOR000Impl.callPricingRulesDataBase() defaults pageNumber to 1 and pageSize to 10 when they are null or non-positive, defaults pricingRuleId, activityId, segmentId and settlementId to -1 when absent, defaults fromDate to 1900-01-01 and toDate to 9990-12-31 when absent, maps onlyActive to active with 1 when null or true and 0 when false, builds FILTERED or ALL flags for status and type depending on whether their lists are populated, and returns an empty pricingRules list when totalElements equals 0 or maps query rows otherwise. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: execute() calls ABKOR000.executeGetPricingRules(filterParams); ABKOR000Impl.executeGetPricingRules() logs the received filters and delegates to callPricingRulesDataBase(), which builds the query parameters, runs GET_COUNT_QUERY and GET_PRICING_RULES_QUERY through jdbcUtils, builds paginationOut with buildPaginationDTO(), maps each row with mapToPricingRuleGetDTO(), maps activities with mapActivities(), maps segment and settlement with mapRelatedEntity(), and maps paymentMethods and customAttributes with Utils.mapPaymentMethodsFromListAgg() and Utils.mapCustomAttributesFromListAgg(). 4. Errors and subsequent actions: in execute(), if getPricingruleid() is not null and lower than 0, addAdvice(ABKO00000050) is triggered with the log text Invalid parameter: pricingRuleId must be non-negative. and Severity.WARN before returning an empty pricingRules list; in execute(), if dataPricingRuleGet.getPricingRules().isEmpty() after ABKOR000.executeGetPricingRules(filterParams), addAdvice(ABKO00000040) is triggered with the log text No Data Founded. and Severity.WARN, and the transaction continues to assign dataOfPricingRules. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: ABKOR000Impl.callPricingRulesDataBase() always sets paginationOut in DataPricingRuleGet, sets pricingRules to Collections.emptyList() when totalElements equals 0 or to the list mapped from GET_PRICING_RULES_QUERY rows otherwise, and execute() always calls setDataofpricingrules(dataPricingRuleGet), so dataOfPricingRules is assigned even when pricingRules is empty.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Retrieves pricing rules by building database query filters, counting matching records, applying pagination, and mapping each returned row to the response DTO.

Error Management.Description of the error situation: Invalid parameter: pricingRuleId must be non-negative.

Input Parameters.Description: Pricing rule identifier used to restrict the database query to a single pricing rule.
Start date used to populate the lower bound of the effective date filter in the database query.
End date used to populate the upper bound of the effective date filter in the database query.
Activity identifier used to populate the activityId database filter parameter.
Segment identifier used to populate the segmentId database filter parameter.
Settlement identifier used to populate the settlementId database filter parameter.
Flag used to populate the active database filter with 1 when null or true and 0 when false.

Page size used to calculate offsetValue and to populate the pageSize database parameter and paginationOut.pageSize.
